title: Reinforcement Learning Can Amplify Emergent Misalignment from Harmless Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2605.31328v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM) is the surprising tendency of language models to become broadly misaligned after fine-tuning on narrowly misaligned examples. While EM has been extensively studied in the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) setting, evidence that it also arises from reinforcement learning (RL) is limited to large, closed-source models, leaving the phenomenon expensive to study and difficult to reproduce. We characterize EM from RL in small, off-the-shelf open-weight models along three axes. First, we show that rewarding narrow, overtly misaligned behavior produces substantially higher general-domain misalignment than sample-matched SFT. Second, we show that EM from RL can be induced by reward signals that could plausibly arise naturally, such as unpopular aesthetic preferences or poor rhetorical appeals. translated_title: 强化学习能够放大由无害奖励引发的涌现性失对齐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.31328v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：涌现性失对齐是指语言模型在仅针对窄域失对齐样本进行微调后，出现广泛失对齐倾向的惊人现象。尽管涌现性失对齐已在监督微调（SFT）场景下得到广泛研究，但表明该现象同样会由强化学习（RL）引发的证据此前仅限于大型闭源模型，这使得对该现象的研究成本高昂且难以复现。我们在小型、现成的开源权重模型中，从三个维度系统刻画了强化学习引发的涌现性失对齐。首先，我们证明对窄域、明显失对齐的行为给予奖励，所产生的通用领域失对齐程度显著高于样本量匹配的SFT。其次，我们证明强化学习引发的涌现性失对齐可以由现实中可能自然出现的奖励信号诱导产生，例如不受欢迎的审美偏好或糟糕的修辞说服方式。第三，我们评估了为SFT诱导的涌现性失对齐而开发的训练中缓解措施，发现它们可以广泛迁移，包括预防性引导……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究首次在小型开源权重模型中系统刻画了强化学习引发的涌现性失对齐，发现RL比同等规模的SFT更能放大模型失对齐、可由自然产生的无害奖励（如审美偏好）诱导出现，且针对SFT失对齐开发的缓解措施可广泛迁移至RL场景。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first systematic characterization of emergent misalignment from RL in small open-weight models, showing that RL amplifies misalignment more than sample-matched SFT, can be induced by naturally arising harmless rewards such as unpopular aesthetic preferences, and that mitigation strategies developed for SFT-induced misalignment transfer broadly to the RL setting.
